visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white beret and a grey sleeveless dress over a cream long-sleeve top, is seen kneeling on a light-colored floor. She is busy packing a silver suitcase, placing folded beige and white clothing into the open mesh compartments. The setting is a brightly lit indoor bedroom with a white bed, beige curtains, and a desk visible in the background. (2) A young man with grey-dyed hair, wearing a navy blue button-down shirt, suddenly appears by leaning through a dark brown doorway. He holds two anime figurines and gestures excitedly with his hands while looking at the woman. She looks up from her suitcase with an annoyed and weary expression. (3) A second young woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a cream hoodie, leans into the frame from behind the man at the doorway. She looks pleadingly toward the woman on the floor, joining in the animated conversation. The hallway behind them is neutrally lit. (4) The woman in the beret stops packing and reacts with a frustrated outburst, her hands held out in exasperation. Mathematical formulas and question mark icons are edited over her as if she is overwhelmed. She then transitions to a cheerful, smiling pose, holding two different figurines against the same bedroom background. (5) A graphic transition reveals a white background with a large red hexagon logo for 'mercari' and a blue floating circle. (6) A screen recording sequence follows, showing a mobile app interface with various categories like bags, electronics, and toys. Various pink and white text overlays appear over the scrolling items. (7) The woman and the grey-haired man are shown sitting together; she holds a yellow smartphone and points at the screen while he watches with an inquisitive look. (8) A final screen recording shows the checkout process on the app, highlighting shipping and payment options. (9) All three characters are back in the bedroom, kneeling behind the open suitcase. They look directly at the camera, cheering and gesturing enthusiastically as they conclude the segment.
